records.jp: なんで呼び出されたかは分かるでしょ？
records.en_original: Do you know why we called you here?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you know why we called you here?
records.en: You know why we called you here, don't you?

records.jp: ……はい
records.en_original: ...Yes.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yes.
records.en: ...Yes.

records.jp: 私たち、何回も言ったよね。<CR>掃除当番はサボらないでねって
records.en_original: How many times have we told you? No skipping cleaning duty!
records.en_auxiliary: How many times have we told you? No skipping cleaning duty!
records.en: We've told you so many times, haven't we?<CR>Don't skip cleaning duty.

records.jp: はい
records.en_original: I'm sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry...
records.en: Yes.

records.jp: 「仏の顔も三度まで」って言うけどさ、<CR>これで何回目？
records.en_original: They say, "fool me once, shame on you, fool me twice shame on me." How many times have you fooled us now?
records.en_auxiliary: They say, "fool me once, shame on you, fool me twice shame on me." How many times have you fooled us now?
records.en: They say even the Buddha loses patience after the third time.<CR>How many times does this make?

records.jp: 五回目です
records.en_original: Five.
records.en_auxiliary: Five.
records.en: Five times.

records.jp: で、でもぉ……
records.en_original: B-but...
records.en_auxiliary: B-but...
records.en: B-but...

records.jp: 言い訳無用！
records.en_original: No excuses!
records.en_auxiliary: No excuses!
records.en: No excuses!

records.jp: 一応聞きますか？
records.en_original: Maybe we should hear her out.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe we should hear her out.
records.en: Should we at least hear her out?

records.jp: 詩帆さぁん……
records.en_original: Shiho...
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho...
records.en: Shiho-saaan...

records.jp: 無駄無駄。どうせ暑くて力が出なかったとか、<CR>布団が私を呼んでたとかそんなのでしょ
records.en_original: What's the point? She'll just give another dumb excuse like it was too hot outside or she fell asleep.
records.en_auxiliary: What's the point? She'll just give another dumb excuse like it was too hot outside or she fell asleep.
records.en: Pointless. It'll just be something like, 'It was too hot and I had no energy,'<CR>or 'My bed was calling me,' right?

records.jp: いやいや、今回は違うんだって。<CR>今回すっぽかしちゃったのはさぁ
records.en_original: No! This time it's different! This time I, uh...
records.en_auxiliary: No! This time it's different! This time I, uh...
records.en: No, no, this time is different.<CR>This time I skipped because...

records.jp: 詩帆さんのためにご飯作ってたんだよ
records.en_original: I was cooking something for Shiho!
records.en_auxiliary: I was cooking something for Shiho!
records.en: I was making food for Shiho-san.

records.jp: えっ……
records.en_original: What...?
records.en_auxiliary: What...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: 普段から料理作ってくれてて、<CR>他の家事も率先してやってくれて
records.en_original: She always cooks for me, and takes initiative to do the other chores.
records.en_auxiliary: She always cooks for me, and takes initiative to do the other chores.
records.en: You always cook for us,<CR>and you take the initiative with the other chores too.

records.jp: そんな詩帆さんに私から何か恩返しできたらなって
records.en_original: So I wanted to do something for her in return.
records.en_auxiliary: So I wanted to do something for her in return.
records.en: So I thought maybe I could repay Shiho-san for that somehow.

records.jp: ま、詩帆さんが自分で作った方が<CR>美味しいと思うけどね！
records.en_original: Though I don't think my cooking is nearly as good as hers!
records.en_auxiliary: Though I don't think my cooking is nearly as good as hers!
records.en: Though I think it'd taste better<CR>if Shiho-san made it herself!

records.jp: ごめんなさい、わたし、そんなことを<CR>してもらってたなんて知らなくて
records.en_original: I'm sorry, I had no idea...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry, I had no idea...
records.en: I'm sorry. I didn't know<CR>you were doing something like that for me.

records.jp: そっか、そんな風に思ってくれてたんだ……
records.en_original: I didn't know you felt that way...
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't know you felt that way...
records.en: Oh... I didn't know you felt that way...

records.jp: 伶那さんのために本を選んでたんだよ
records.en_original: I was getting a book for Rena.
records.en_auxiliary: I was getting a book for Rena.
records.en: I was choosing a book for Rena-san.

records.jp: 私に？
records.en_original: For me?
records.en_auxiliary: For me?
records.en: For me?

records.jp: 伶那さん前にさ、自分は理系だから<CR>もっと文系寄りの知識をつけたいって言ってたじゃん
records.en_original: Rena you mentioned that since you were always more into science, that you'd be interested in learning more about the arts.
records.en_auxiliary: Rena you mentioned that since you were always more into science, that you'd be interested in learning more about the arts.
records.en: Rena-san, you said before that since you're science-oriented,<CR>you wanted to gain more humanities knowledge too, remember?

records.jp: そういうの楽しく学べる小説ないかなって<CR>図書室で探してたんだよ
records.en_original: So I went to the library to find an interesting book that might help you out.
records.en_auxiliary: So I went to the library to find an interesting book that might help you out.
records.en: I was looking in the library for a novel<CR>that would let you learn that kind of thing while having fun.

records.jp: 別に頼んでないし
records.en_original: I don't remember asking you to do so.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't remember asking you to do so.
records.en: I didn't ask you to.

records.jp: ……まぁ、掃除サボった時間が無駄になるって言うなら<CR>読んであげてもいいけど
records.en_original: ...But if it means something will come of the time you wasted skipping cleaning duty, I might as well read it.
records.en_auxiliary: ...But if it means something will come of the time you wasted skipping cleaning duty, I might as well read it.
records.en: ...Well, if not reading it would mean the time you wasted skipping cleaning was pointless,<CR>I suppose I could read it for you.

records.jp: 日菜子さんのためにトレーニングしてたんだよ
records.en_original: I was training for Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: I was training for Hinako.
records.en: I was training for Hinako-san.

records.jp: 私のため？　どういうこと？
records.en_original: For me? What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: For me? What do you mean?
records.en: For me? What do you mean?

records.jp: たまに一緒にトレーニングするとさ、<CR>私すぐバテて離脱しちゃうじゃん
records.en_original: When we train together I usually get tired pretty quick and have to stop.
records.en_auxiliary: When we train together I usually get tired pretty quick and have to stop.
records.en: When we train together sometimes,<CR>I get exhausted right away and have to drop out, don't I?

records.jp: せっかく日菜子さんとするなら、<CR>できるだけついていきたいなって
records.en_original: I want to be able to keep up with you.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to be able to keep up with you.
records.en: Since I get to train with you, Hinako-san,<CR>I want to keep up for as long as possible.

records.jp: その方が楽しいでしょ？
records.en_original: Don't you think it'd be more fun that way?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't you think it'd be more fun that way?
records.en: It'd be more fun that way, right?

records.jp: それは、そうかもしれないけど
records.en_original: You're not wrong, but...
records.en_auxiliary: You're not wrong, but...
records.en: That may be true, but...

records.jp: こういう時にそういうこと言うの……ズルい
records.en_original: How am I supposed to get mad at you for skipping work now...
records.en_auxiliary: How am I supposed to get mad at you for skipping work now...
records.en: Saying something like that at a time like this... is unfair.

records.jp: じゃ、そういうことで。<CR>私ちょっと片付けしてくるから
records.en_original: Anyways, I'll go start tidying up.
records.en_auxiliary: Anyways, I'll go start tidying up.
records.en: Well, that's settled.<CR>I'm going to go clean up a little.

records.jp: なんだ勇希が写真を投稿しただけか。<CR>「愛央とフェイスペインティングに挑戦」
records.en_original: Looks like Yuki uploaded a picture. It says, "Face-Painting Challenge with Ao".
records.en_auxiliary: Looks like Yuki uploaded a picture. It says, "Face-Painting Challenge with Ao".
records.en: Oh, it was just Yuki posting a photo.<CR>"Trying Face Painting with Ao."

records.jp: ん？
records.en_original: Hmm?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm?
records.en: Hm?

records.jp: どうしました？
records.en_original: What is it?
records.en_auxiliary: What is it?
records.en: What's wrong?

records.jp: 後ろの時計、見て
records.en_original: Look at the clock in the background.
records.en_auxiliary: Look at the clock in the background.
records.en: Look at the clock in the background.

records.jp: ……ちょうど掃除時間ですね
records.en_original: ...That's supposed to be cleaning time.
records.en_auxiliary: ...That's supposed to be cleaning time.
records.en: ...That's right during cleaning time.

records.jp: わたしたちも急ぎましょう
records.en_original: Let's hurry.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's hurry.
records.en: Let's hurry too.

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay!
records.en: Yeah!
